the RFPT-based control method is a powerful tool to achieve quasi-optimal solutions in the adaptive control problems of chemical reaction systems; the use of fractional derivatives in the prescribed control error relaxation function increases considerably the sampling time, which is a practically relevant design factor in the adaptive control design of chemical reaction systems.
the fractional order derivatives can be applied in the adaptive control design of chemical reaction systems to achieve better results in terms of the control performance.

the use of fractional derivatives in the prescribed relaxation of the error in the control of chemical reaction systems can significantly increase the necessary cycle time and, consequently, the sampling frequency can be reduced.
